journey.name: LandscapeTwoColumnLayout
journey.description: Verifies the two-column landscape layouts for the Question screen and the Game Over screen. Rotates the device to landscape before starting, then plays through a game to reach Game Over, checking that both screens render their expected content in side-by-side columns without overlap.

actions.action: Rotate the device to landscape orientation.
Tap the 'Regular Season' button. Verify the trivia question screen appears showing a 'Score:' label and a 'Lives:' label in a header row at the top of the screen.

Verify a hockey trivia question text is visible on the left side of the screen and player answer buttons are visible on the right side of the screen, confirming the two-column landscape layout is active.

Tap the first player answer button. Verify that either 'Correct!' or 'Incorrect!' feedback text appears in the header area at the top of the screen, and verify the 'Next' button appears on the left side of the screen, beneath the question text (not in the right-hand answer column).
Tap the 'Next' button. Verify a new trivia question is displayed with the question on the left and answer buttons on the right.

Answer questions repeatedly — intentionally tapping wrong answers each time to deplete all lives — until the Game Over screen appears. For each question: tap any answer button, wait for feedback, then tap 'Next'. Repeat until 'Game Over' text is displayed on screen.
Verify the Game Over screen shows 'Game Over' text and 'Score:' text in the left column, and the 'Play Again' button is visible and tappable in the left column.
Verify the right column of the Game Over screen shows 'High Scores' text (if any scores exist) or is empty (if this is the first game). The screen must not show any overlapping or clipped content.
Tap the 'Play Again' button. Verify the app returns to the start screen or immediately shows a new trivia question screen.
